findings.question: q-geometry-triangles-0001
findings.quote: This leaves out angle B when subtracting from $180^\circ$. Subtracting one known angle starts the calculation. Check that both given angles are included.
findings.problem: The note for $115^\circ$ names the wrong omitted angle. Subtracting only angle B gives 180 - 65 = 115, so this answer leaves out angle A. Leaving out angle B instead gives 180 - 55 = 125.
findings.fix: Change "leaves out angle B" to "leaves out angle A".
